title: Dutch museum moon rock turned out to be petrified wood

tellings.quote: And then you have the Apollo Goodwill tour where I think it was through Neil Armstrong, the American ambassador, ended up with this moon rock or whatever, went to the the former prime minister of the Netherlands gave him the thing.

plain: After the first Moon landing in 1969, during a goodwill tour by the Apollo astronauts, the American ambassador to the Netherlands gave a former Dutch prime minister a supposed moon rock, which ended up in a Dutch museum and later turned out to be petrified wood. Michels brings it up himself, in an episode about the comedian Joe Rogan, a little unsure of the details, saying he thinks it came through the astronaut Neil Armstrong. He uses it to ask what else about official space history might not be what it seems.
